========================================================
  phorg — Storage Organizer
========================================================

WHAT IT DOES
  Cleans up and organizes messy folders on your PC (and
  Android phones over USB), safely. Highlights:
    - Organize by type / size / date / GPS location
    - Junk sweep, fix broken extensions, remove empties
    - Find duplicate files (byte-identical AND look-alike)
    - Bulk rename with templates, and "Recommended cleanup"
    - Photo AI: sort a photo dump by what's IN each picture
      (portraits, couples, groups, blurry, best shots,
      screenshots, documents) and by a named person's face
    - Wedding sorter: group a wedding-day photo dump into
      event folders (Muhurtham, Sadhya, Reception...) by time
    - Compress images LOSSLESSLY to reclaim space
    - Undo anything (even one folder at a time)

HOW TO RUN
  1. Double-click  phorg.exe
  2. A small black window opens and your web browser opens
     automatically with the app.
  3. Use the app:
        - Connect  -> pick a folder (or an Android phone)
        - Organize -> choose an action, PREVIEW, then Apply
        - Photo AI / Wedding / Compress -> in the sidebar
        - Tip: press Ctrl+K anytime for a command palette
  4. To quit: close the black window.

IS IT SAFE?
  Yes. It ONLY MOVES files — it never deletes them. Every
  action shows a full preview first, and you can untick any
  folders you'd rather leave alone. Nothing changes until you
  click "Apply". After applying, it re-counts your files to
  prove none were lost, and you can Undo (all, or just one
  folder). System folders are protected. Photo analysis runs
  100% on your PC — nothing is ever uploaded.

NOTES
  - Windows may show a "Windows protected your PC" warning the
    first time (because the app isn't code-signed). Click
    "More info" -> "Run anyway".
  - No installation and no Python needed. It's a single file
    (~90 MB, because it bundles the offline photo-AI tools).
  - Everything runs locally on your computer. Nothing is
    uploaded anywhere.

Enjoy a tidier drive!
